title: Game Theory Meets Large Language Models: A Systematic Survey with Taxonomy and New Frontiers

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies that deploy LLMs as agents in foundational matrix games (e.g., Dictator Game, Ultimatum Game, Prisoner's Dilemma) to measure their tendencies to prioritize fairness, altruism, and cooperation over pure game-theoretic rationality.

Surveying literature and benchmarks (such as FAIRGAME and SmartPlay) that test LLM decision-making in strategic, zero-sum, and repeated games to evaluate deviations like prompt sensitivity, risk aversion, and bounded rationality.
